∀ {kind : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.ResourceKind} (child parent : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Capability kind) (parentage : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Parentage), child.Attenuates parent parentage ↔ child.parent = Option.some parent.id ∧ child.root = parent.root ∧ child.issuer = parent.issuer ∧ child.scope.Narrows parent.scope parentage ∧ parent.notBefore ≤ child.notBefore ∧ child.notAfter ≤ parent.notAfter ∧ child.issuerEpoch = parent.issuerEpoch ∧ child.policyId = parent.policyId ∧ child.policyEpoch = parent.policyEpoch ∧ child.ancestors = Insert.insert parent.id parent.ancestors ∧ parent.channels ⊆ child.channels

∀ {kind : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.ResourceKind} (request : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Request kind) (child parent : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Capability kind) (parentage : Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Parentage), Minidregg.Theory.CredentialAuthorityFamily.DelegationShape request child parent parentage ↔ child.Attenuates parent parentage ∧ parent.holder = Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Holder.subject request.subject ∧ child.holder ≠ Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Holder.bearer ∧ request.verb = Minidregg.Theory.CredentialAuthorityFamily.delegateVerb kind ∧ (child.scope.targets = Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.TargetSet.explicit {request.target} ∨ child.scope.targets = Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.TargetSet.under request.target.value) ∧ parent.scope.Covers parentage request ∧ parent.notBefore ≤ request.height ∧ request.height ≤ parent.notAfter ∧ parent.policyId = request.policyId ∧ parent.policyEpoch = request.policyEpoch
